ios.desc:
Are you sick of playing Never Have I Ever or Kings Cup at pre-drinks or at a party?

Introducing Drink and Tell, the ultimate and fun drinking game to play with a Tinder date or lots of friends at a party. Forget complicated rules and the same old classic games (Spin the Bottle, Never Have I Ever, Beer Pong, Truth or Dare, King’s Cup etc), Drink and Tell is fun for everyone!
With over 500,000 downloads in the Apple store, find out what all the fuss is about!

How to play:
Select from our 6 categories or randomise them. Take turns answering taboo questions from multiple choice answers. Once everyone has guessed what they think you would pick, swipe to reveal the answer. The friends who guessed wrong, have to drink!

Features:
- Play with one friend, or one hundred at the same time
- Play on just the one phone
- Diverse and taboo questions to trigger conversation
- Draw a new question by simple, swipe functionality

Play one of the many exciting categories or randomise them!

Categories include:
- Love
- Sex
- Ethics
- Personality
- Life and Death
- User Generated

Update: NEW fun categories added to purchase:
- Embarrassing
- Pop Culture
- Would You Rather
- Adults Only
- Relationships
- Outrageous
- Politics
- Mixed


Uncover all your friends deepest, darkest secrets, all while you drink!

SUBSCRIPTION INFO

Truth or Dare now allows you to purchase a subscription to unlock everything, and remove all ads from the game. You will constantly get updated cards and enjoy all the premium benefits.

* Subscription length is 1 month and the price is 5.99$/month
* Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term.
* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
* You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by cancelling your subscription through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.

Please, make sure to read our privacy policy

quotes.text:
My friend and I made a drinking game app called 'Drink and Tell' which is better than Kings Cup and Never Have I Ever. Take turns answering taboo questions while your friends have to guess which multiple choice answer you'd pick. Those who guess wrong, drink!

But are apps defeating the purpose of socially drinking?

Download it here and let me know your thoughts? https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/drink-and-tell/id977435351?ls=1&mt=8

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.blackmarket.drinkandtell

http://drinkandtellapp.com/
quotes.title: Are drinking game apps just as good?
